accepted_boundary.output_format: signed-int64 container holding Q12.20 logits after exact causal-row maximum centering and exact HEAD64 scale 1/8
accepted_boundary.output_frame: The existing QKSPOU01 schema-version-2 frame is unchanged: 24-byte header, row_length signed-int64 scores, then the authoritative valid-key bitmap.
accepted_boundary.public_packing_api: pack_normalized_row(query, keys, valid_mask, alternative_id) validates encoded heads and bitmap, then performs groupwise dot-product normalization internally; callers cannot supply derived scores, row_common_exponent, or argmax_index.
accepted_boundary.realization: For valid key k, realize centered_k * 2^(row_common_exponent+17), round once to nearest ties to even when right shifting, reject any positive result, saturate only values below signed-int64 minimum, and emit canonical integer +0 after underflow or exact zero.

encoding.all_zero_group: All 16 mantissas are zero and the stored exponent is exactly signed zero.
encoding.decoder: For lane i in group g, represented_value[i] = signed_int8_mantissa[i] * 2^signed_group_exponent[g].
encoding.exponent_selection: For each contiguous 16-lane group independently, choose the least integer e such that every finite BF16 source value x in the group satisfies abs(x) <= 127 * 2^e.
encoding.mantissa_quantization: round x * 2^-e to nearest integer, ties to even; saturation and clamp are forbidden
encoding.nonzero_canonicality: A nonzero group must have maximum absolute mantissa in [64,127], making the least-exponent representation fail-closed and unique for represented group values.
encoding.rank_loss_mechanism_addressed: Four independently selected exponents prevent a large lane in one 16-lane region from forcing the quantization step of all other 48 lanes. This is a structural statement only, not a numerical-improvement claim.

groupwise_dot_product.alignment: Across every valid key and all four groups, choose row_common_exponent as the minimum nonzero group_product_exponent. Align each nonzero group partial exactly by left shifting it by group_product_exponent-row_common_exponent, then sum the four aligned terms for that key.
groupwise_dot_product.group_partial: partial[k,g] = sum over the 16 lanes in group g of q_mantissa[i] * k_mantissa[k,i]
groupwise_dot_product.group_product_exponent: q_group_exponent[g] + k_group_exponent[k,g], signed range -278 through 244; a zero partial does not participate in row exponent selection
groupwise_dot_product.row_all_zero: If every valid-key group partial is zero, row_common_exponent is exactly zero.
groupwise_dot_product.row_centering: Choose the exact maximum aligned score over valid keys, lowest key index on ties, and subtract it from every valid aligned score before Q12.20 realization.

packing.exponent_layout: bytes 64..71 contain four signed-int16 group exponents in increasing group order
packing.mantissa_layout: bytes 0..63 are signed-int8 lane mantissas in increasing lane order

static_dataflow.multiplier_count_if_fully_unrolled: 64 signed 8x8 multipliers, unchanged from a fully unrolled per-head dot product
static_dataflow.reduction_shape: four exact 16-product partial reductions feeding exponent-tagged alignment and one signed-543 score accumulator
static_dataflow.streaming_interface: Consume one 72-byte query-head record and one 72-byte key-head record under the abstract streaming-memory boundary; no tensor, model, descriptor, RTL, or live command namespace is created by this contract.

encoding.all_zero_group: All 8 mantissas are zero and the stored exponent is exactly signed zero.
encoding.decoder: For lane i in group g, represented_value[i] = signed_int8_mantissa[i] * 2^signed_group_exponent[g].
encoding.exponent_selection: For each contiguous 8-lane group independently, choose the least integer e such that every finite BF16 source value x in the group satisfies abs(x) <= 127 * 2^e.

encoding.rank_loss_mechanism_addressed: Eight independently selected exponents reduce the sharing domain to eight lanes, further isolating large-magnitude lanes. This is a structural statement only, not a numerical-improvement claim.

packing.exponent_layout: bytes 64..79 contain eight signed-int16 group exponents in increasing group order
packing.mantissa_layout: bytes 0..63 are signed-int8 lane mantissas in increasing lane order

static_dataflow.multiplier_count_if_fully_unrolled: 64 signed 8x8 multipliers, unchanged from a fully unrolled per-head dot product
static_dataflow.reduction_shape: eight exact 8-product partial reductions feeding exponent-tagged alignment and one signed-543 score accumulator
static_dataflow.streaming_interface: Consume one 80-byte query-head record and one 80-byte key-head record under the abstract streaming-memory boundary; no tensor, model, descriptor, RTL, or live command namespace is created by this contract.

arithmetic_width_closure.aligned_group_term: G16 requires at most signed 541 bits for a signed-19 partial shifted by 522; G8 requires at most signed 540 bits for a signed-18 partial shifted by 522.
arithmetic_width_closure.aligned_key_score: signed 543 bits. The absolute sum over all groups is bounded by 64*127*127*2^522 = 1032256*2^522 < 2^542.
arithmetic_width_closure.centered_key_score: signed 544 bits for exact subtraction of two signed-543 aligned scores
arithmetic_width_closure.group_exponent: canonical nonzero range -139 through 122; minimum exact signed width 9; stored signed-int16
arithmetic_width_closure.group_product_exponent: range -278 through 244; minimum exact signed width 10; stored or carried signed-int16
arithmetic_width_closure.lane_product: exact range -16129 through 16129; minimum exact signed width 15
arithmetic_width_closure.q12_20_realization_intermediate: signed 805 bits or wider: signed-544 centered value left shifted by at most 261 when row_common_exponent+17 is nonnegative
arithmetic_width_closure.row_common_exponent: minimum nonzero group_product_exponent over every valid key and group, signed 10 bits and stored signed-int16

hardware_constraints.static_disposition: Both alternatives use bounded integer fields, finite reductions, fixed group counts, and deterministic shifts and are hardware-realizable at the contract level. Compliance with the 2.0 mm2 cap and 100 MHz floor remains unclaimed until separately authorized canonical SKY130 synthesis and OpenSTA evidence exists.

input.source: finite BF16 post-RoPE Q and K values supplied only under a future separately frozen diagnostic authority
input.zero_semantics: Both positive and negative BF16 zero encode as integer mantissa zero. No negative-zero state exists after encoding.

malformed_input_policy.atomicity: Validate the complete query record, every key record including masked keys, the complete bitmap, row length, and exact output-frame fields before publishing any score or packed byte.
fail_closed_conditions: wrong Python type or bool supplied where an exact integer is required
wrong head, group, row, payload, bitmap, or frame length
group exponent outside -139 through 122 for a nonzero group
zero group with exponent other than zero
nonzero group whose maximum absolute mantissa is below 64
nonzero group whose maximum absolute mantissa exceeds 127
nonzero output flags or reserved fields
caller-supplied normalized scores, row common exponent, or argmax at the public packing boundary
output argmax index whose valid score is not canonical integer zero
positive centered or realized valid score
malformed_input_policy.repair_policy: No inference, defaulting, truncation, canonical repair, compatibility alias, partial publication, or field substitution is permitted.

objective: Freeze exactly two software-only, hardware-realizable grouped-exponent Q/K score representation successors after the immutable Base c02 negative result, without loading models or tensors, invoking an evaluator, computing new scores, creating execution authority, or modifying RTL or stage state.

packing_common.head_record_selection: The alternative is selected by a separately checksummed future interface contract; records carry no self-describing tag and are rejected if their exact length does not match the selected alternative.
packing_common.normalized_output: The accepted QKSPOU01 output frame and authoritative valid-key bitmap are unchanged. Public packing accepts only encoded query, encoded keys, valid_mask, and alternative_id, and derives scores, row_common_exponent, and argmax_index internally. Unpacking rejects any frame whose valid argmax slot is not canonical integer zero.
packing_common.record_order: mantissas first in increasing lane order, then signed-int16 exponents in increasing contiguous-group order, no padding or trailing bytes

prohibited_actions: deserialize or inspect either sealed Q/K tensor bundle
load or execute Base or checkpoint-176 models
invoke the c02 evaluator or transaction surface
compute candidate, diagnostic, calibration, model, or official scores
materialize checkpoint-176 c02 or replay Base c02
create live authority, candidate, attempt, command, descriptor, or execution namespaces
modify RTL, U280, XRT, HBM2, manifests, constraints, or stage state
claim numerical improvement, RTL correctness, synthesis, timing, area, frequency, coverage, benchmark PASS, or Stage 1 completion

recommendation.basis: Advance only this alternative into a separately authorized, new-version diagnostic package because it removes the 64-lane shared exponent while adding 6 bytes per head rather than 14, uses four rather than eight exponent paths and aligned terms, and retains the same proven worst-case 543/544/805-bit arithmetic bounds as G8.
recommendation.diagnostic_requirements: A future package must use a new identifier and freshly frozen inputs, evaluator, score policy, tool versions, and exactly-once authority. It must not reuse Base c02 authority or materialize checkpoint-176 under the consumed Base gate.
recommendation.ppa_condition: Recommendation is for diagnostic eligibility only; later accelerator adoption still requires fresh executable RTL verification, canonical SKY130 synthesis/OpenSTA evidence, source and constraint hashes, and independent Reviewer acceptance under the 2.0 mm2 and 100 MHz constraints.

rounding.bf16_encoding: round to nearest, ties to even, using exact BF16 integer fields and powers of two; host floating point and libm are forbidden
rounding.dot_products: exact signed integer multiply and add with no rounding, saturation, clamp, or requantization
rounding.q12_20_boundary: the sole post-encoding rounding boundary; use guard/round/sticky-equivalent round-to-nearest ties-to-even on the nonnegative magnitude, then restore sign

common.row_state: one signed-16 row exponent, one signed-543 exact maximum, one unsigned-16 argmax index, plus implementation-selected buffering for a maximum 512-key row

static_resource_comparison.interpretation: G8 offers finer exponent isolation but doubles exponent reads and aligned terms versus G16 and adds 384 more key-cache bytes per token over 24 layers. No area, timing, energy, or numerical ranking is inferred from these static counts.
